notes: «قال أبو داود رواه يونس وعقيل وشعيب وسعيد بن عبد العزيز عن الزهري ... مرسلا» names four other transmitters for the same saying, without the Companion: a variant group, not a route of this chain
ruling asked: the variant is a «ورواه X عن Y» remark that drops the Companion («مرسلا»); whether it is a different chain or only a lesser version is not settled by the rules
«زعم الوليد» is read as the verb «زعم» and the name «الوليد» alone
